02 — About

Ashil Jeejo is a director, writer, creative director and documentarist working across film, advertising and music. He has a particular dislike for template-driven filmmaking and predictable visual language, and prefers to approach each project on its own terms. His focus is on making choices that have a reason behind them, while keeping the film clear, engaging and distinct.

His early work in advertising gave him experience in developing ideas within real production constraints, from the initial concept and structure through to execution. That background continues to influence the way he approaches filmmaking, particularly in how he thinks about pacing, communication, visual choices and the relationship between an idea and its audience.

Alongside filmmaking, Ashil has a background in music. He works as a vocalist and music director and has composed music for short films. Working across both film and music has given him a hands-on understanding of rhythm, performance and sound, which often becomes part of the way he approaches a film rather than something added at the end.

Ashil holds a B.Com degree and a Diploma in Visual Media Communication, combining a background in commerce with formal training in visual media.

His work includes Twerk (2025), for which he is credited as writer and creative director. The film was featured at the 17th International Documentary & Short Film Festival of Kerala (IDSFFK). He was also the creative director of the documentary Chehre (2025). Earlier work includes 202 B (2021), written and directed by him and featured in the Lift-Off Global Network, London; The Voices (2020), which he wrote and directed; and Silma Nadan (2020), for which he worked as music director.
